label: SIMULATION — NOT PHYSICAL-SYSTEM VALIDATION

scenario.title: Independent sensor failure or unavailable evidence
scenario.attempted: An attacker raises the setpoint to +2 °C while the independent temperature evidence fails: P1 sticks, P2 and the air probe stop reporting.

submissions.label: Corrective action: restore the authorized baseline

steps.detail: Independent EIN status EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT; on-call technician and facility manager notified (simulated).
FM-01 issues a fresh, scoped corrective authority to TECH-01.

outcome: Baseline was NOT restored within the run. Simulated product peaked at 1.46 °C and spent 1138 min above -18 °C; at the end it was 1.46 °C. Product disposition is not decided by TA-14.

claims.basis: Ground truth deviated from minute 212 (max product 1.46 °C) but the EIN never established a deviation from its evidence.
3 evidence gaps opened; NORMAL ever claimed without evidence: false.
Chain valid: true (591 entries); sealed baseline unchanged: true; missing entry types: none.

unproven: In this run the controller's own alarm, an untrusted channel, fired while the independent evidence was missing. The simulated architecture does not let untrusted signals authorize correction, so the corrective action was held and the product kept warming. How untrusted signals should feed an emergency path is an open design question, not a demonstrated capability.
Any emergency procedure for acting without admissible evidence. Real sites need one; it is not modelled here.
Physical-system behaviour: the thermal model is illustrative and unvalidated.
Real controller protocols, network paths and attacker capabilities were not tested.
Detection depends on independent sensors existing, being installed correctly and staying independent of the compromised path.

baseline.thresholdBasis: Configured for this simulation. -18 °C is a commonly cited frozen-storage temperature; site limits must come from the operator's food-safety plan and equipment documentation.

payload.note: The last authorized baseline is sealed and stored separately from observed reality.
